dct_description_sm: This dataset was downloaded from Ottawa Police Services Traffic Stop Race Data Collection Project TSRDCP (via Internet Archive) and is provided as is.

The Traffic Stop Race Data Collection Project (TSRDCP) required Ottawa police officers to record their perception of the driver’s race, by observation only, for traffic (motor vehicle) stops over a two-year period from June 27, 2013 to June 26, 2015. A total of 81,902 records of traffic stops were examined.

The TSRDCP is the result of a settlement agreement between the Ottawa Police Services Board and the Ontario Human Rights Commission (OHRC). This data was originally released in this form on the Ottawa Police web site, which is now only accessible through the Internet Archive.
